patterns.name: parametric_circle
patterns.formula: x = r*cos(theta); z = r*sin(theta); theta += step

patterns.name: parametric_helix
patterns.formula: x = r*cos(theta); y += dy; z = r*sin(theta); theta += step

patterns.name: trail_queue
patterns.formula: deque of last N player locations; spawn along stored points

patterns.name: rotation_matrix
patterns.formula: apply yaw/pitch matrix to 2D shape offsets

patterns.name: inward_attraction
patterns.formula: vector = center - particle; velocity += vector * strength
